loss_mechanism.formula: en_best = max_k score[k,0] (unconditional net, cung don vi labels ch0); mean_pos = mean(relu(en_best)) tren train-batch (causal, train-only, khong leak tuong lai); coverage_loss = LAMBDA_COV * relu(1 - mean_pos/FLOOR_POS)^2

params.TEMP_NOTE: khong dung sigmoid-mean (tai margin sigmoid=0.5 lam floor vo nghia); relu-mean chi dem mass duong that su

loss_mechanism.why_scaled: Chuan hoa theo floor de penalty ~LAMBDA (=3.0, cung cap base loss ~1-2) khi model hoan toan nhat (mean_pos=0); gradient/mau ~ 2*LAMBDA*(1-mean_pos/floor)/(floor*n), du lon de day mass duong.

policy_mechanism.fallback: neu gate cho < 8 tin hieu trong mot fold-test, lay bu top-N_MIN theo en_best (pre-spec, ap dung giong nhau moi fold/seed, khong tune theo PnL)
policy_mechanism.global_floor_math: 8 x 11 fold-tests lien tuc (khong overlap) ~= 88 tin hieu global toi thieu >> fills gate 30 (du tru dedup/overlap)
policy_mechanism.primary_gate: en_best > 0.0 (zero-margin, CHU Y co tinh long hon P10/P50 gates cua v28 von gay coverage 0.28%)
